help_guide:
❓ *Beginner User Guide*

1. 🏨 *Select Hotel*: Pick your assigned hotel on registration.
2. 🛒 *Place Order*: Browse item categories or upload your product list.
3. 📦 *Track Orders*: Tap 'My Orders' to see live status & driver updates.
4. 🌐 *Language*: Tap 'Language' anytime to switch between English, Amharic, and Afaan Oromoo.

Need further assistance? Contact your administrator.

👨‍💻 Developed by [Yusuf Mohammed](https://yusuf-mohammed.vercel.app/)
